title: ENDEX: Incident Closed — Verification Complete

fields.resolution: ENDEX. The control system remains isolated, and the plant continues to operate in full manual mode under 24/7 oversight. The Ohio EPA DDAGW has confirmed two clean sample rounds, and the final lab report has been filed. The Do Not Drink advisory has been lifted across Zone 1, and all critical customers have been notified. The water quality is confirmed safe, and the incident has been formally closed under ERP Section 13.
finalState: The water quality in Zone 1 is confirmed at pH 7.8 and caustic 4.0 mg/L — within safe limits.
The Do Not Drink advisory has been officially lifted via MillbrookAlert and the city website.
The control system has not been restored to automatic mode; manual operation continues under full oversight.
All forensic evidence has been submitted to CISA, FBI, and WaterISAC for attribution and analysis.
The final lab report (24-1190) and DDAGW-ELR-2026 submission are filed in the ERP-3 sample logs.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Place your radios, phones, and devices on the table. We are now moving into the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: How did the team maintain public trust during the loss of system integrity?
What would have changed if the HMI had not been compromised and the system had shown correct values?
How did the manual control transition impact response times and operational confidence?
What lessons were learned from the delayed vendor access and the need for signed access requests?
How should the utility balance speed of recovery with security when returning to automatic control?
